items.summary:
Please note that development logs are different from official announcements. The content in this post is still being discussed and refined based on your feedback, and the final implemented version may differ.

In the previous development log, we temporarily removed the additional Silver rewards for the Regional D-Effect Zone, the adjustment involving Emergency Gnosis, and the Covenant Combination feature. However, after reassessing the plan, we believe that the better approach is not to remove these elements outright, but to continue improving upon the original proposal. The revised version is outlined below.

## 1. Emergency Gnosis

** Emergency Gnosis will remain usable in the Regional D-Effect Zone. Each use consumes 3 Emergency Gnosis. After use, the Training Points earned from that clear will not count toward the Rankings.**

This will make it a contingency tool that requires planning, rather than a method that can be overly relied upon to clear content. At the same time, excluding these results from the Rankings ensures that they do not interfere with ranking outcomes and helps preserve fairness in high-end challenges.
  └ angbak:

items.summary:
## In Closing

We sincerely apologize that the information in the development logs has changed several times within a short period, causing confusion in both understanding and discussion.

However, this is precisely why we remain committed to sharing development logs in advance: to gather your feedback as early as possible, identify blind spots in our thinking, and make the most appropriate decision at the time—even if that decision means overturning our previous one.

Rather than appearing unwavering on the surface, we would rather do what truly needs to be done while there is still time to revise the plan. Going forward, we will also continue improving the way and pace at which we communicate through development logs, so that communication between the development team and the community can be smoother.

**After the V2.6 update, we will provide Token of Concord ×5 and Origin of Time ×5 to help everyone better adapt to changes in the game’s systems and challenges.**

Seeing the community proactively help us collect and organize feedback has been deeply moving. We are sincerely grateful to every Keeper who has taken the time to share their thoughts. It is through everyone’s collective contribution and participation that Morimens can continue moving forward, even through its twists and turns.
  └ ko.nur:

items.summary:
This isn't usually a simple fixed number — it varies depending on differences between enemies and fluctuates from season to season. The multiplier for individual stages within each difficulty tier stays unchanged, but the average difficulty across all stages within each tier drops by about 0.5 tiers — that's roughly how you can think of it.
  └ nirski: so basically nightmare will still be a step up in difficulty over alert 5, but not as severe as before?
  └ fishhazardthewizard: In that case, compared to the current Alert 5, how many times higher would the Nightmare or Madness boss HP be?
  └ nirski: I want to make it clear that many of the primary concerns when it comes to HP inflation come about because not every awakener can infinitely scale their damage - there are many currently powerful awakeners who will just fall off the meta entirely if HP becomes too high, leading high level play becoming narrow and unfun.

Additionally, the poison and counter caps are a big problem for the viability of these archetypes and would **need** to be revisited to maintain their clear capabilities.

I do not know the numbers expected for these new endgame mode thresholds, so I can't say either way, but these are our concerns. If the final product doesn't address them, it *will* inevitably feel bad for many.

items.title: [DC] sacred_promises@🔸有問必答┊official-q-a: my 2nd feedback this time  For dtide  1) The new system favours vertically inves
items.summary:
my 2nd feedback this time

For dtide 
1) The new system favours vertically invested teams instead of horizontal invested teams. Since points increase by 10 each difficulty, while doing an extra clear on the same difficulty gives only 5 points. 

What does this mean? This causes less team building variety and encourages pulling for absolute axiom AA to make a single team clear the highest difficulty for the most points. 

Who does this affect? Mostly free to play / low spender players that have a wide roster of low invested e0~e3 units. This is basically the majority of the player base. 

My thoughts is to rework the point system that balances both vertical & horizontal investment. Much like the current dtide 10x alert 4 = 5x alert 5 = 400 points

2)The new nightmare / madness difficulties seemingly only have their hp increase 2-3x and damage 30-60% each tier. 

What does this mean? This either translate to 1 or 2 things. Either, existing units have to be buffed in order to make them viable against this difficulty and future releasing units will have increasing higher power floor / ceilings. If that is not the case, this means pulling for OE/AA becomes an ever increasing demand just to play higher level difficulties in dtide. 

Who does this affect? Majority of the player base who are not whales / big spenders. 

My thoughts are if BIAV cares about powercreep and truly believes in what they said about “OE/AA being not needed in content”, explore different ways to increase dtide difficulty instead of blinding increasing hp & damage. 

Allowing skill expression is satisfying thing in morimens and should be prioritise instead of wallet flexing. 

I hope biav looks into this seriously as this is likely the biggest factor that can improve or worsen the game’s power creep, monetisation, and balance.
items.author: sacred_promises

items.title: [DC] nirski@🔸校貓日誌┊schoolcat’s-notes: I want to make it clear that many of the primary concerns when it comes to HP in
items.summary:
I want to make it clear that many of the primary concerns when it comes to HP inflation come about because not every awakener can infinitely scale their damage - there are many currently powerful awakeners who will just fall off the meta entirely if HP becomes too high, leading high level play becoming narrow and unfun.

Additionally, the poison and counter caps are a big problem for the viability of these archetypes and would **need** to be revisited to maintain their clear capabilities.

I do not know the numbers expected for these new endgame mode thresholds, so I can't say either way, but these are our concerns. If the final product doesn't address them, it *will* inevitably feel bad for many.
  └ lightproud: In our testing, poison and counter builds are still able to hold up, so there are no plans to adjust them for now. If the need arises, we'll make adjustments to help them out. Thank you for the clarification.

items.summary:
## 2、融灾禁区
**困难、噩梦、癫狂难度的第 1—4 波次强度将会下调，整体更接近上一档难度第 5 波的水平。 **

旧版每档难度的 5 个波次强度较为接近，仅存在一定波动；新版将重新调整波次之间的难度曲线，让挑战强度从第 1 波到第 5 波更加平滑地逐步提升，其中第 5 波将始终是最具挑战性的部分。这将为玩家留下更明确的学习和适应过程，也让持续挑战的体验更加友好。 

**相应地，噩梦难度仍然会增加 1250 银芯奖励。 **

我们理解部分新玩家对此存在压力和顾虑。同时也想说明：自开服以来，游戏在各个系统、活动等免费内容中累计新增的银芯和抽数奖励，早已远超融灾禁区同期的总产出。 新玩家的追赶速度实际上在不断加快，旧角色的实力强化也在持续发生。高强度挑战带来的奖励差额，远小于这些常驻渠道带来的补充。即便是精粹灵核碎片，我们也已经在其他渠道提供了更多获取方式。 

在这个背景下，我们认为，为高强度挑战提供适当的银芯奖励是恰当的——付出足够努力的守密人，理应得到更多回报。 

我们也会确保普通玩家在获取这些银芯奖励时，仍然具备合理的通关可能性。唤醒体的超限爆发或最终法则可以让通关更加轻松，但不应该成为通关所必需的门槛。如果实际情况偏离了这一目标，我们会在后续作出修正。
  └ heikwok: 話說這方面希望製作組可以特別注意一下
只是假設
假設未來3.0改版後靈塑全數失效，由於部分角色有一大部分強度及機制綁定靈塑，將會是相對沉重的打擊
希望融災方面也可以及時作出相應調整，或是補救措施之類的，而不是等一段長時間後再作補強
畢竟2.0開頭就是這種情況，結果搞半年才開始調整就有點太晚了

items.title: [DC] shadow_blings_31584@🔸校貓日誌┊schoolcat’s-notes: 1.融灾难度调整：（1）只开放n6，难度基于之前n4、n5之间的数值差，恢复之前n4、n5一倍的血量和攻击差，着重调整n5-n6的数值倍数 （2）n6奖励放置少
items.summary:
1.融灾难度调整：（1）只开放n6，难度基于之前n4、n5之间的数值差，恢复之前n4、n5一倍的血量和攻击差，着重调整n5-n6的数值倍数
（2）n6奖励放置少量养成材料，不放抽卡资源。并设置挑战成功的限时称号，每年打过几次会给予永久称号
（3）细化每个区间的奖励，现在每50分才给予奖励太苛刻，恢复之前25分一档奖励的设置
2.创造额外营收：缺少多元化营收就会过度关注竞技数值。
（1）出皮肤：一种是出官方投票和单独问卷，只出高人气角色皮肤售卖，质量达到旺达、蜘蛛那种皮肤的水准就能卖爆
这个最好需要额外招人做
（2）有些命轮的卡面也可以直接用来做皮肤卖
（3）提高大大月卡的奖励，目前大大月卡奖励都没有实质性的养成材料，很多玩家都认为缺少性价比而放弃购买
3.改善运营公告：有恶性bug第一时间通知玩家，然后再发布修复公告。避免再出现福袋、诞墨、蚀萝的情况
  └ lingyujiling: 青天大老爷
